plan.title: Live RFQ counter offer remains pending

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ Responses screen with the vendor bid already present.
Ensure counter offers are visible on RFQ rounds.
Ensure eRFX project flows are enabled for the prepared RFQ.
Open the buyer comparison grid where the vendor's live bid can be countered.
Send a buyer counter offer at 90 on the vendor's live bid; the catalog cannot target only line 1.
Assert that the buyer grid records the counter offer as initiated.
Move to the invited vendor's separate supplier-portal session while leaving the buyer session open.
Open the prepared event's pricing round where the vendor can see the pending counter offer.
Assert that the vendor sees the pending counter offer.
Attempt a vendor revision while the counter offer is pending and require the portal to refuse it.
Return to the buyer's event page.
Return to the buyer's Responses view to inspect the still-pending offer.
Assert that the counter-offer state remains visible after the vendor does not answer.
Open Master QCS to inspect the current bid comparison after the pending counter offer.
Assert that the displayed line amounts and total are arithmetically consistent with the current prices in the prepared grid.
